biotools.summary: iS2C2 is a novel cointelligent platform that merges rigorous computational algorithms with the contextual reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate interpretable hypotheses from single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics data. It specializes in mechanistic discovery of disease-related cellular crosstalk.
